question: is A2x's gain specific to its global-local mechanism, or would any 2x-compute ensemble give it? F2 is the cost-matched generic control the incumbent must beat.
F2: two independent full-frame P5 states: original video and horizontally flipped video (lazy flip of the official frame tensor, flipped prompt); output = mean of the two sigmoid probability maps (flipped one flipped back exactly) > 0.5. Output-only, no memory exchange. Applied to every unit of DAVIS_val + PUMaVOS_B (67).

decision_rules.incumbent_specific: A2x small-unit dJF (gate set, 15) exceeds F2's by >= 0.005 -> the targeted mechanism matters; else A2x's gain is not specific
decision_rules.F2_as_challenger: F2 overall dJF >= A2x overall + 0.003 with video CI of the paired difference > 0 (F2 is not novel; it would only change the baseline)
